pedagogical_summary.one_sentence: DeepSeek-V3 introduces a 671B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with auxiliary-loss-free load balancing and multi-token prediction, achieving cost-efficient training and state-of-the-art performance on open-source benchmarks.
pedagogical_summary.problem: Large language models face bottlenecks in training efficiency, expert load imbalance, and high computational costs, limiting scalability and performance gains despite architectural advancements.
pedagogical_summary.solution: DeepSeek-V3 employs Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), DeepSeekMoE with auxiliary-loss-free load balancing, multi-token prediction training, and FP8 mixed-precision training to optimize inference, training stability, and cost-effectiveness.
